Provide a ShoppingBasket class in shopping_basket.py. A new basket is empty. Calling add_item(name, price) adds one item with a non-negative integer price. Calling item_count() returns the number of items. Calling total_price() returns the sum of all item prices. Adding bread for 3 and milk for 2 must produce an item count of 2 and a total price of 5. Keep all state in memory and use no external dependencies.
